## Engineering Student | Propulsion, Fluid Dynamics & Experimental Engineering

I am an Engineering student at Harvey Mudd College interested in **propulsion, fluid dynamics, aerospace systems, and experimental engineering**.

I conduct research in Harvey Mudd's Flow Imaging Research Lab, where I study **bio-inspired flapping-fin propulsion** using force measurements, high-speed imaging, Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV), and MATLAB-based data analysis.

My research investigates how fin orientation, geometry, aspect ratio, and interaction with the free surface influence propulsive performance and wake dynamics. I will present this work at the **APS Division of Fluid Dynamics Annual Meeting in November 2026**.

I am also a member of the **propulsion subteam of the Mudd Amateur Rocketry Club (MARC)** and a co-founder and Co-President of Harvey Mudd's chapter of the **Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE)**.

I am currently interested in opportunities involving **propulsion, fluid and thermal systems, aerospace engineering, experimental testing, and mechanical systems**.
